title: YR-04 FIRE LORD
summary: I bought this kit for simple reason: passing time while waiting for Zhao Yun from Motor Nuclear and Bandai's MG Vidar. The result is mixed. It's a straight build so let's go over it quickly!
pros: Glorious looking, especially with full effects.
No troublesome gimmick, everything is straight out of the runners and onto the kit.
Huge. It's as big as MG Sazabi and the weapons are refreshing to look at.
The water decals, instead of bunch of text and lines, are patterns and they are necessary to give Fire Lord a unique look. Don't sleep on it!
cons: Snap fit is not 10/10. There are problems through the build at various places that you need to use force to put them together. Likely 7.5/10
Gate placement is questionable, especially the effects. You need to pay attention to where you cut or else mistake will be made. Sometimes it is difficult to tell.
The head. It's bland. I think they spent too much time choosing the body parts until last minute they pick a random head to slap it on. Would swap to an alternative when it is available.
Decal quality is a bit low. Easy to mess up. Be careful.
